name: Air Fryer Crispy Italian "Antipasto" Egg Rolls with Sun-Dried Tomato Aioli

instructions.primary_message: Drain and roughly chop pepperoncini, olives, and artichoke hearts. Place all three in a medium bowl, along with cheese, and stir to combine the filling.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup pepperoncini peppers, sliced
1 cup Kalamata olives, pitted
2 (106 g) jar artichoke hearts, marinated
1 ½ cups shredded cheese, Italian blend

instructions.primary_message: Arrange egg roll wrappers, side by side, on a flat surface with a corner pointing up (in a diamond shape). Place one slice of salami in the center of each wrapper, then divide filling between them (use a scant ¼-cup). Fold the bottom point of the wrapper up and over the filling, fold in side points, then carefully roll to the top. Use wet fingers to seal the top point down. Transfer "egg rolls" to a large plate.

Spray air fryer basket with cooking spray. Working in batches to best fit the size of your air fryer, add egg rolls to the basket, spacing them at least ½-inch apart. Coat rolls with more cooking spray.
Insert basket into the air fryer and set temperature to 400°F. Cook, flipping halfway through, until egg rolls are golden and crispy, 10-12 minutes. Remove basket from air fryer.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and juice lemon into a small bowl. Add pesto and mayo, then stir to combine the aioli.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ lemon
⅓ cup sun-dried tomato pesto
¼ cup mayonnaise

instructions.primary_message: Arrange egg rolls on a platter and serve with aioli on the side. Enjoy!
